reference_sql:
WITH copied_sets AS (  -- one row per set of two or more matching 2024 lines
  SELECT o.store_id, ol.order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.store_id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT s.store_code, SUM(cs.n_lines - 1) AS n_copies, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.order_id) AS n_orders
FROM copied_sets cs
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = cs.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code

solver.query:
WITH sets AS (SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_lines GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur)
SELECT st.store_code, SUM(s.n - 1) AS n_copies, count(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS n_orders
FROM sets s
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN stores st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE s.n > 1 AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY st.store_code
